text.en:
12th. 2014 No. S 33

WORKPLACE SAFETY AND HEALTH ORDER, 2009 (S44/2009) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1) of the Workplace Safety and Health Order, 2009, the Minister of Home Affairs, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st August 2013 as the date on which that Order shall be deemed to have commenced. Made this 30th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of April, 2014.

PEHIN UDANA KHATIB DATO PADUKA SERI SETIA

USTAZ HAJI A WANG BADARUDDIN BIN

PENGARAH DATO PADUKA HAJI OTHMAN Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
